summary: Fix OIDC JWT failures by editing the authenticator and entering supported algorithms (for example RS256, ES256, PS256) as a YAML list or JSON array in OIDC JWT Algorithm(s), taken from the IdP discovery endpoint.
questions: How do I set JWT algorithms for OIDC in AAP?
Which JWT algorithms should I enter?

answer_card.title: Set OIDC JWT Algorithm(s)
answer_card.answer_md:
Access Management > Authentication Methods > your OIDC authenticator > **Edit**, then set *OIDC JWT Algorithm(s)* to the list from your IdP's discovery endpoint:
```json
["RS256", "RS384", "RS512", "ES256", "ES384", "ES512", "PS256", "PS384", "PS512", "HS256", "HS384", "HS512"]
```
